{{ block title }}Task 2 – Instructions and Decision{{ endblock }} {{ block content }}

You now have 40 points. In this task, you need to decide the portion of these points (between 0 and 40 points, inclusive) that you wish to invest in a risky option. Those points not invested are yours to keep.

The risky investment: With 50% chance, the investment will succeed, and you will receive 2.5 times the amount you invested; with 50% chance, the investment will fail, and you will lose the amount you invested.

After your decision, the computer will randomly determine whether the risky investment is successful or not, each with equal chance.

Your final points equal the sum of those points not invested and the outcome from the risky investment. Suppose you invest R points (R between 0 and 40 points, inclusive) to the risky investment, if the risky investment succeeds, your final points are (40-R)+2.5R; if the risky investment fails, your final points are 40-R. You will receive GBP 0.01 for each final point you have.

Note that this is a one-time decision.
